Name: Volcano Button Tracker
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
[size=4]Volcano Button Tracker

[/size][size=3]This is a simple mod that notifies you of how many buttons are left to press before you can advance to the next Volcano Dungeon level. If you're tired of finding the exit of a massive level just to realize it's still blocked by a gate, then this mod is for you!

Source available on [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/VolcanoButtonTracker]GitHub[/url]﻿.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Volcano Button Tracker
Manifest.Description: Shows a popup message to let you know how many more buttons you need to press to advance to the next level in the Volcano Dungeon.
